front: lift zone
back: 升降機分區
examples: Those lifts do not serve the 23rd floor.
I'll show you the correct lift zone.
The lifts are divided into different zones.
examples_zh: 那些升降機不到二十三樓。
我會帶您到正確的升降機分區。
升降機分為不同分區。

front: lift bank
back: 升降機組
examples: I'll accompany you to the correct lift bank.
Please follow me to the correct lift bank.
This lift bank serves your destination floor.
examples_zh: 我會陪同您前往正確的升降機組。
請跟我前往正確的升降機組。
這組升降機可前往您的目的樓層。

front: destination floor
back: 目的樓層
examples: Please confirm your destination floor.
Lift H is the correct lift for your destination.
If the destination floor is unclear, ask before directing.
examples_zh: 請確認您的目的樓層。
H 升降機是前往您目的樓層的正確升降機。
如果目的樓層不清楚，帶路前先查問清楚。

front: nearest lift
back: 最近的升降機
examples: I'll just take the nearest lifts here.
The nearest lift may not serve your floor.
Please check the lift zone before using the nearest lift.
examples_zh: 我就使用這裡最近的升降機。
最近的升降機未必能到您的樓層。
使用最近的升降機前，請先確認升降機分區。

front: QR receipt
back: QR 離場憑證
examples: What is this QR receipt for?
Please keep the QR receipt with you during your visit.
Keep the QR receipt until you have passed through the exit gate.
examples_zh: 這張 QR 離場憑證有甚麼用途？
到訪期間，請隨身保留 QR 離場憑證。
請保留 QR 離場憑證，直至通過出口閘機。

front: QR code
back: QR 碼
examples: Please scan the QR code at the exit gate.
My QR code isn't scanning.
Please scan your QR code at the gate before leaving.
examples_zh: 請在出口閘機掃描 QR 碼。
我的 QR 碼掃描不到。
離開前，請在閘機掃描您的 QR 碼。

front: exit gate
back: 出口閘機
examples: The exit gate is on your left-hand side.
Please scan the QR code at the exit gate.
The main exit is just ahead after the gate.
examples_zh: 出口閘機在您的左手邊。
請在出口閘機掃描 QR 碼。
通過閘機後，主出口就在前方。

front: secured area
back: 保安管制區
examples: Scan the QR code to leave the secured area.
The QR receipt is used when leaving the secured area.
If the QR code does not scan, do not force the gate.
examples_zh: 請掃描 QR 碼離開保安管制區。
離開保安管制區時需要使用 QR 離場憑證。
如果 QR 碼掃描不到，請不要強行推開閘機。

front: ground floor (G/F)
back: 地下／G/F
examples: We've arrived at the ground floor.
I can accompany you back to G/F.
The exit gate is on your left when we reach G/F.
examples_zh: 我們已到達地下。
我可以陪同您返回地下。
到達地下後，出口閘機在您的左邊。

front: CS counter
back: 客戶服務櫃位
examples: Would you mind waiting by the CS counter?
Please come back to the CS counter for assistance.
You only need to return to the counter if you need help.
examples_zh: 介意在客戶服務櫃位旁等候嗎？
如需協助，請返回客戶服務櫃位。
只有需要協助時，您才需要返回櫃位。

front: Those lifts do not serve the 23rd floor.
back: 那些升降機不到二十三樓。
examples: Just a moment, please. Those lifts do not serve the 23rd floor.
The lifts are divided into different zones.
Please use Lift H on your right to access the 23rd floor.
examples_zh: 請稍等。那些升降機不到二十三樓。
升降機分為不同分區。
請使用右邊的 H 升降機前往二十三樓。

front: Please use Lift H on your right to access the 23rd floor.
back: 請使用右邊的 H 升降機前往二十三樓。
examples: Please use Lift H on your right to access the 23rd floor.
Lift H is the correct lift for your destination.
I'll show you to the correct lift bank.
examples_zh: 請使用右邊的 H 升降機前往二十三樓。
H 升降機是前往您目的樓層的正確升降機。
我會帶您到正確的升降機組。

front: The lifts are divided into different zones.
back: 升降機分為不同分區。
examples: The lifts are divided into different zones.
These lifts do not serve the 23rd floor.
You'll need the correct lift zone for your destination.
examples_zh: 升降機分為不同分區。
這些升降機不到二十三樓。
您需要使用前往目的樓層的正確升降機分區。

front: I'll accompany you to the correct lift bank.
back: 我會陪同您前往正確的升降機組。
examples: I'll accompany you to the correct lift bank.
Please follow me; I'll lead the way.
I'll show you the correct lift zone.
examples_zh: 我會陪同您前往正確的升降機組。
請跟我來；我會帶路。
我會帶您到正確的升降機分區。

front: Please keep the QR receipt with you during your visit.
back: 到訪期間，請隨身保留 QR 離場憑證。
examples: Please keep the QR receipt with you during your visit.
You'll need the QR receipt when you return to G/F.
Keep it with you until you have exited through the gate.
examples_zh: 到訪期間，請隨身保留 QR 離場憑證。
返回地下時，您會需要使用 QR 離場憑證。
請保留憑證，直至通過閘機離開。

front: When you return to G/F, scan the QR code at the exit gate.
back: 返回地下時，請在出口閘機掃描 QR 碼。
examples: When you return to G/F, scan the QR code at the exit gate.
Scan the code before leaving the secured area.
The exit gate is on your left-hand side.
examples_zh: 返回地下時，請在出口閘機掃描 QR 碼。
離開保安管制區前，請先掃描 QR 碼。
出口閘機在您的左手邊。

front: Please keep the QR receipt until you have passed through the exit gate.
back: 請保留 QR 離場憑證，直至通過出口閘機。
examples: Please keep the QR receipt until you have passed through the exit gate.
Do not discard the receipt before you leave the secured area.
Once you are through the gate, you no longer need it.
examples_zh: 請保留 QR 離場憑證，直至通過出口閘機。
離開保安管制區前，請不要丟掉憑證。
通過閘機後，便不再需要保留憑證。

front: Not unless you need assistance.
back: 除非您需要協助，否則不用。
examples: Do I need to return to the counter afterwards? Not unless you need assistance.
Only return to the counter if you need help.
Otherwise, keep the QR receipt and proceed to the exit gate.
examples_zh: 之後需要返回櫃位嗎？除非您需要協助，否則不用。
只有需要幫忙時才返回櫃位。
否則，請保留 QR 離場憑證並前往出口閘機。

front: Please don't force the gate.
back: 請不要強行推開閘機。
examples: Please don't force the gate.
If the QR code does not scan, let me check it for you.
Please come back to the CS counter for assistance if needed.
examples_zh: 請不要強行推開閘機。
如果 QR 碼掃描不到，讓我替您檢查。
如有需要，請返回客戶服務櫃位尋求協助。

front: Let me check the QR receipt and assist you with the exit gate.
back: 讓我檢查 QR 離場憑證，並協助您使用出口閘機。
examples: Let me check the QR receipt and assist you with the exit gate.
No problem. I'll see why the QR code is not scanning.
Please wait here while I check the receipt.
examples_zh: 讓我檢查 QR 離場憑證，並協助您使用出口閘機。
沒問題，我會看看為甚麼 QR 碼掃描不到。
請在這裡稍候，讓我檢查憑證。

front: escort
back: 陪同／護送
examples: I can escort you back to G/F.
Thank you for escorting me down.
A security officer may escort a visitor to the correct lift.
examples_zh: 我可以陪同您返回地下。
多謝您陪同我下來。
保安員可陪同訪客前往正確的升降機。

front: I'm ready to leave.
back: 我準備離開了。
examples: Excuse me. I'm ready to leave.
My meeting has finished, and I'm ready to leave.
If you are ready to leave, I can show you the way back.
examples_zh: 不好意思，我準備離開了。
我的會議已經結束，我準備離開。
如果您準備離開，我可以帶您返回大堂。

front: I'm not familiar with the way back to the main lobby.
back: 我不熟悉返回主大堂的路線。
examples: I'm not familiar with the way back to the main lobby.
I wasn't sure which lift to use.
Certainly. I can accompany you back to G/F.
examples_zh: 我不熟悉返回主大堂的路線。
我不確定應該使用哪部升降機。
當然可以，我可以陪同您返回地下。

front: I can accompany you back to G/F and show you the exit.
back: 我可以陪同您返回地下，並帶您到出口。
examples: I can accompany you back to G/F and show you the exit.
Please follow me to the correct lift.
Once we reach G/F, I'll point out the exit gate.
examples_zh: 我可以陪同您返回地下，並帶您到出口。
請跟我前往正確的升降機。
到達地下後，我會指示出口閘機的位置。

front: Please follow me; I'll lead the way to the correct lift.
back: 請跟我來；我會帶您前往正確的升降機。
examples: Please follow me; I'll lead the way to the correct lift.
We'll use this lift back to G/F.
I'll accompany you down and show you the exit.
examples_zh: 請跟我來；我會帶您前往正確的升降機。
我們會乘搭這部升降機返回地下。
我會陪同您下樓，並帶您到出口。

front: We've arrived at the ground floor.
back: 我們已到達地下。
examples: We've arrived at the ground floor.
The exit gate is on your left-hand side.
Please scan the QR codebefore leaving the secured area.
examples_zh: 我們已到達地下。
出口閘機在您的左手邊。
離開保安管制區前，請先掃描 QR 碼。

front: The exit gate is on your left-hand side.
back: 出口閘機在您的左手邊。
examples: The exit gate is on your left-hand side.
Once we reach G/F, the exit gate will be on your left.
Please follow the signs after you pass through the gate.
examples_zh: 出口閘機在您的左手邊。
到達地下後，出口閘機會在您的左邊。
通過閘機後，請跟隨指示牌前往出口。

front: Please follow the signs to the exit.
back: 請跟隨指示牌前往出口。
examples: Please follow the signs to the exit.
The exit gate will be on your left when we reach G/F.
The main exit is just ahead after the gate.
examples_zh: 請跟隨指示牌前往出口。
到達地下後，出口閘機會在您的左邊。
通過閘機後，主出口就在前方。

front: The main exit is just ahead after the gate.
back: 通過閘機後，主出口就在前方。
examples: The main exit is just ahead after the gate.
Please scan your QR code first, then continue straight ahead.
Have a pleasant afternoon.
examples_zh: 通過閘機後，主出口就在前方。
請先掃描 QR 碼，然後繼續向前行。
祝您下午愉快。

front: Have a pleasant afternoon.
back: 祝您下午愉快。
examples: Have a pleasant afternoon.
You're very welcome. Have a pleasant afternoon.
Use this phrase to close the interaction politely.
examples_zh: 祝您下午愉快。
不用客氣，祝您下午愉快。
可用這句話有禮貌地結束對話。

front: normal office hours
back: 正常辦公時間
examples: The tenant's normal office hours have already ended.
The office normally closes at 6:00 p.m.
After normal office hours, verify the host before allowing access.
examples_zh: 租戶的正常辦公時間已經結束。
辦公室通常在下午六時關門。
正常辦公時間後，讓訪客進入前要先核實接待人。

front: still available
back: 仍然有空／仍可接待
examples: I'll need to verify that Ms Chan is still available.
Although the office is closed, the host may still be available.
Let me contact the office and check whether your host is still available.
examples_zh: 我需要先核實 Chan 女士是否仍可接待您。
即使辦公室已關門，接待人仍可能在辦公室。
讓我聯絡辦公室，確認您的接待人是否仍可接待您。

front: contact the office
back: 聯絡辦公室
examples: What I can do is contact the office now.
Let me contact your host and verify the appointment.
I haven't been able to reach the office yet.
examples_zh: 我現在可以聯絡辦公室。
讓我聯絡您的接待人並核實預約。
我暫時仍未能聯絡到辦公室。

front: receive confirmation
back: 收到確認
examples: I'm unable to send you upstairs until I receive confirmation.
Please wait while I contact the tenant for confirmation.
Once I receive confirmation, I can give you the next step.
examples_zh: 在收到確認前，我未能讓您上樓。
請稍候，讓我聯絡租戶取得確認。
收到確認後，我便可以告訴您下一步。

front: send you upstairs
back: 讓您上樓
examples: I need confirmation before I can send you upstairs.
I'm unable to send you upstairs until the tenant confirms the visit.
Once the visit is confirmed, you may proceed upstairs.
examples_zh: 我需要先取得確認，才可以讓您上樓。
在租戶確認到訪前，我未能讓您上樓。
到訪獲確認後，您便可以上樓。

front: The tenant's normal office hours have already ended.
back: 租戶的正常辦公時間已經結束。
examples: The tenant's normal office hours have already ended.
I'll need to verify that Ms Chan is still available.
I understand you have an appointment, but access still needs confirmation.
examples_zh: 租戶的正常辦公時間已經結束。
我需要先核實 Chan 女士是否仍可接待您。
我明白您有預約，但仍需要先確認才可進入。

front: I'll need to verify that Ms Chan is still available.
back: 我需要先核實 Chan 女士是否仍可接待您。
examples: I'll need to verify that Ms Chan is still available.
She told you she would be in the office, but I still need to check.
Please wait here while I contact the office.
examples_zh: 我需要先核實 Chan 女士是否仍可接待您。
即使她說會留在辦公室，我仍需要先核實。
請在這裡稍候，讓我聯絡辦公室。

front: What I can do is contact the office now and let them know you've arrived.
back: 我現在可以聯絡辦公室，通知他們您已到達。
examples: What I can do is contact the office now and let them know you've arrived.
I'll try to reach your host immediately.
Would you mind waiting here while I check?
examples_zh: 我現在可以聯絡辦公室，通知他們您已到達。
我會立即嘗試聯絡您的接待人。
我查詢期間，介意在這裡稍候嗎？

front: I'm unable to send you upstairs until I receive confirmation from the tenant.
back: 在收到租戶確認前，我未能讓您上樓。
examples: I'm unable to send you upstairs until I receive confirmation from the tenant.
I understand you're already late, but I still need confirmation.
Please wait by the CS counter while I contact the office.
examples_zh: 在收到租戶確認前，我未能讓您上樓。
我明白您已經遲到，但我仍需要先取得確認。
請在客戶服務櫃位旁稍候，讓我聯絡辦公室。

front: I don't want to promise a time before I reach them.
back: 在聯絡到他們之前，我不想承諾所需時間。
examples: I'll check immediately, but I don't want to promise a time before I reach them.
It may only take a few minutes, but I cannot guarantee a time.
I'll update you as soon as I hear back.
examples_zh: 我會立即查詢，但在聯絡到他們之前，我不想承諾所需時間。
可能只需要幾分鐘，但我不能保證所需時間。
一有回覆，我會盡快通知您。

front: Would you mind waiting by the CS counter?
back: 介意在客戶服務櫃位旁等候嗎？
examples: Would you mind waiting by the CS counter?
I'll contact the office while you wait.
Thank you for waiting. I'll update you as soon as I have confirmation.
examples_zh: 介意在客戶服務櫃位旁等候嗎？
您等候期間，我會聯絡辦公室。
多謝等候；一有確認，我會盡快通知您。

front: The tenant has confirmed that Ms Chan is in the office.
back: 租戶已確認 Chan 女士仍在辦公室。
examples: The tenant has confirmed that Ms Chan is in the office.
Thank you for waiting, Mr Wong.
You may proceed to the 19th floor.
examples_zh: 租戶已確認 Chan 女士仍在辦公室。
Wong 先生，多謝您等候。
您現在可以前往十九樓。

front: You may proceed to the 19th floor.
back: 您現在可以前往十九樓。
examples: You may proceed to the 19th floor.
The visit has now been confirmed.
Please use the correct lift zone and keep your QR receipt.
examples_zh: 您現在可以前往十九樓。
到訪現已獲確認。
請使用正確的升降機分區，並保留 QR 離場憑證。

front: Please keep your QR receipt for the exit gate when you leave.
back: 離開時，請保留 QR 離場憑證以便使用出口閘機。
examples: Please keep your QR receipt for the exit gate when you leave.
You'll need the receipt when you return to G/F.
Scan the QR code at the gate before leaving the secured area.
examples_zh: 離開時，請保留 QR 離場憑證以便使用出口閘機。
返回地下時，您會需要使用這張憑證。
離開保安管制區前，請在閘機掃描 QR 碼。

front: May I ask which floor you came from?
back: 請問您是從哪一層下來的？
examples: May I ask which floor you came from?
This helps me confirm which lift lobby you used.
Once I know the floor, I can direct you to the correct exit.
examples_zh: 請問您是從哪一層下來的？
這有助我確認您使用了哪個升降機大堂。
知道樓層後，我便可以指示您前往正確出口。

front: The exit gate is on the other side.
back: 出口閘機在另一邊。
examples: The exit gate is on the other side.
You're standing on the wrong side of the lift lobby.
Please follow me and I'll point out the exit gate.
examples_zh: 出口閘機在另一邊。
您現在站在升降機大堂的另一側。
請跟我來，我會指示出口閘機的位置。

front: Please come back to the CS counter for assistance.
back: 請返回客戶服務櫃位尋求協助。
examples: Please come back to the CS counter for assistance.
If the QR code still does not scan, I'll check it at the counter.
Please don't force the gate while we check the problem.
examples_zh: 請返回客戶服務櫃位尋求協助。
如果 QR 碼仍然掃描不到，我會在櫃位替您檢查。
我們檢查問題期間，請不要強行推開閘機。

front: I understand you have an appointment.
back: 我明白您有預約。
examples: I understand you have an appointment.
The office is outside normal hours, so I still need confirmation.
I'll try to contact your host for you.
examples_zh: 我明白您有預約。
辦公室已過正常辦公時間，所以我仍需要先取得確認。
我會嘗試替您聯絡接待人。

front: I still need confirmation before I can send you upstairs.
back: 在讓您上樓前，我仍需要確認。
examples: I still need confirmation before I can send you upstairs.
A message on your phone does not replace confirmation from the office.
Please wait while I try to reach your host.
examples_zh: 在讓您上樓前，我仍需要確認。
您電話上的訊息不能取代辦公室的確認。
請稍候，讓我嘗試聯絡您的接待人。

front: I haven't been able to reach the office yet.
back: 我暫時仍未能聯絡到辦公室。
examples: I haven't been able to reach the office yet.
I understand you have an appointment, but I cannot allow access without confirmation.
I'll explain the next realistic step if no one answers.
examples_zh: 我暫時仍未能聯絡到辦公室。
我明白您有預約，但未有確認前我不能讓您進入。
如果沒有人接聽，我會向您說明下一個可行安排。
